newsitem.title: UK: Argentina global bond sees strong performance.
newsitem.headline: Argentina global bond sees strong performance.

text.p: The spread on Argentina's $2.0 billion 20-year global bond moved in by nearly 40 basis points and could tighten further, traders said on Thursday.
The deal, priced on Wednesday to yield 462.5 b.p. over the August 2026 U.S. Treasury bond, was quoted at 425 b.p. over at 1200 GMT.
There was room for a further 10 b.p. move, dealers said.

"The Mexico 2016 dollar global is 60 b.p. wide to its 2007 deal," said a debt trader at a European bank. "Argentina's new global is trading 65 b.p. wider than its 2006 paper, so we may have another five to 10 b.p. tightening."
"Argentina's deal offered value against the market, hence the sharp spread move," said another trader.
Spreads on other Latin American Eurobonds moved in by around five b.p. on Argentina's strong perfromance, dealers said.
Mexico's 10-year global bond launched recently was trading at 295 b.p. over Treasuries. It was issued at a 335 b.p. spread, and on Wednesday was quoted at 302 b.p.
